speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify the severity of your leg pain and check for other specific symptoms. Have you noticed any bone aches that made it hard to walk or move? Also, have you had any swelling in your hands or feet recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: That severe night pain is a significant red flag; does the pain specifically worsen when you bend your knees or stretch your legs? Additionally, have you noticed any tiny red spots on your skin (petechiae) or any lumps under your jaw or armpits?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and Peripheral Blood Smear.
REQUEST TEST: Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) and C-Reactive Protein (CRP).
REQUEST IMAGES: Full body skeletal survey X-ray.

Please wait for these results while we assess if the pain is positional, as the combination of fever, fatigue, bruising, and severe bone pain is highly concerning for leukemia or a severe bone infection.
